description.en-US:
Retreat Player plays MP3s of dhamma talks, bells, and chanting during a
meditation retreat — built on the same principle as Retreat Timer: once
playback starts, nothing interrupts it.

* Every recording is downloaded into the app's own storage when it is loaded,
  so playback needs no network — airplane mode is fine.
* Playback runs in a foreground service holding a wake lock: the system
  cannot kill or pause it, even with the screen off for an hour-long talk.
* The screen stays on while a recording plays — no lock, no screensaver —
  showing the progress the whole time.
* A recording plays only because you pressed play, and only once: when it
  ends, nothing else starts automatically.

Loading and organising:

* Tap + to load recordings from the phone, from a shared kDrive folder
  (public link — read-only, no password), or from a podcast feed; the link
  and feed URLs are remembered for next time.
* Tiles are filed into two sections — Bells & chanting on top (used every
  day), then Dharma talks — and ordered by hand with arrows.
* The player shows elapsed and remaining time together, with play, pause,
  stop, 10-second jumps, and back-to-beginning.

No ads, no tracking, no accounts.
